extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia contributors / editors attempting to create a new article
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for contributors who want to create a new Wikipedia article, including account requirements, submission alternatives, troubleshooting visibility, and title/redirect considerations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmation requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Creators must have a Wikipedia account and meet the autoconfirmed status before creating an article; no further details provided on this page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use article wizard or request a new article as alternatives
rubrics_metrics.description: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you cannot directly create a page (e.g., not autoconfirmed), use the article wizard to prepare a draft or file a request so experienced editors can review or create the article.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search existing articles first
rubrics_metrics.description: Search for "Domino's Pizza YouTube video incident" in existing articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before creating a new page, search Wikipedia to check for alternative titles, spellings, or existing coverage to avoid duplication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Look for pages that link to this title
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Checking inbound links can reveal existing coverage or appropriate target pages for redirects or merges.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recent-creation visibility delays / purge troubleshooting
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created here, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database; wait a few minutes or try the purge function.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When a just-created page does not appear, wait briefly for propagation, and use the purge function to refresh cached database views.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title capitalization and redirect consideration
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; please check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect here to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verify capitalization and alternative spellings; if the canonical article exists under a different capitalization or phrasing, create a redirect rather than a duplicate page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check the deletion log if the page was deleted
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log, and see 'Why was the page I created deleted?'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you suspect the page was removed, consult the deletion log to learn reasons for deletion and appeals or revision steps.
